history.text: I run a car repair shop and want a voice agent to answer our calls.

Happy to build that. 1) Which calls should it handle (bookings, repair status, price questions)? 2) What should it collect from the caller? 3) Any safety or escalation rules? 4) How should a call end? I can assume sensible defaults for anything you skip.

prompt: Bookings, repair status and price questions. Collect name, phone and the vehicle make, model and year. If the car is unsafe to drive, tell them not to drive it and offer towing. Angry or legal callers get an urgent callback task. Use your defaults for the rest.
